Class BetaReturnToBaseCommand

java.lang.Object
model.player.command.mystery.BetaReturnToBaseCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command
public final class BetaReturnToBaseCommand extends Object implements Command
Sends a Beta-restricted piece or blockade back to Base after two rolls of 3 in a row (T-13).
